# Setup

## Load libraries and dataset
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(jtools)
library(psych)
library(EFAtools)
library(lavaan)
hsls <- haven::read_dta("hsls_subset.dta") # can use numeric values
df <- hsls %>% haven::as_factor() #make it factors
```
# Reliability and Validity

## Subset Parent Questions for pa Year
```{r}
psd <- hsls %>% dplyr::select(s1momtalkm, s1dadtalkm, s1momtalks, s1dadtalks)
phbae <- hsls %>% dplyr::select(par_exp1, par_asp1, able_ba1)
home <- hsls %>% dplyr::select(par_exp1, par_asp1, able_ba1, s1momtalkm, s1dadtalkm, s1momtalks, s1dadtalks)

```

## Reliability
```{r}
psych::alpha(psd)
psych::alpha(phbae)
psych::alpha(home)

```

#  Linear Regression
```{r}

lm <- lm(data = hsls,
 scale(x3tcredmat) ~ # do this by semester since there are half credits
    psd_scale + phbae_scale + par_sch_inv + # parent factors
    as.factor(x1race) + frpl + par_ba + female + # ses/demographics
    s1m8 + x1txmtscor + # prior achievement
    x1mtheff + x1mthuti + x1mthint + x1mthid + # affective
    as.factor(x1locale) + x1control) # school level


summ(lm)

```

# Logistic Regressin
```{r}
glm <- glm(data = df,
 adv_math ~ # do this by semester since there are half credits
    psd_scale + phbae_scale + par_sch_inv + # parent factors
    as.factor(x1race) + frpl + par_ba + female + # ses/demographics
    s1m8 + x1txmtscor + # prior achievement
    x1mtheff + x1mthuti + x1mthint + x1mthid + # affective
    as.factor(x1locale) + x1control, # school level
 family = binomial)


summ(glm, exp = TRUE)

```
